title: CPC-2026-4893-CA
text:
CPC-2026-4893-CA  Council District: Citywide
  CEQA: ENV-2026-4894-SE; ENV-2020-6762-EIR  Last Day to Act: 01-05-27
  ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1; ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2
  Plan Area: Citywide

  PUBLIC HEARING REQUIRED

  PROJECT SITE:  Citywide

  PROPOSED CODE AMENDMENT:
  The proposed Housing Element Sites and Minimum Density Amendment Ordinance (HESMD Amendment
  Ordinance) is a citywide Code Amendment in Chapters 1 and 1A of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC)
  that will: 1) clarify eligibility and review procedures, 2) permit a project to utilize adjacent sites, and 3) improve
  clarity and internal consistency by correcting errors, omissions, or ambiguous language.

  The proposed Lower Income Sites Ordinance (LI Sites Ordinance) is a citywide ordinance that will: 1) adopt
  the Lower Income Rezoning Housing Element Sites List by ordinance; and 2) update the Lower Income
  Rezoning Housing Element Sites List consistent with current eligibility and site standards to ensure continued
  compliance with state law requirements.

  The Housing Element Sites and Minimum Density Ordinance (HESMDO) was adopted in February of 2025
  and established a ministerial review process for Prior Housing Element Sites and Lower Income Rezoning
  Housing Element Sites that provide at least 20 percent of units as affordable and available to Lower Income
  Households, locally codifying Housing Element Law in Government Code 65583.2.

  REQUESTED ACTIONS:
  1. Find and recommend the City Council find, based on the whole of the administrative record in the
  independent judgment of the decision maker, that the Proposed Project is statutorily exempt under the
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to the California Public Resources Code Section
  21080.085(a); and find that the Project was assessed in the Housing Element Environmental Impact
  Report (“EIR”) Number ENV-2020-6762 (SCH No. 2021010130) certified on November 29, 2021, and
  Addenda 1 and 2 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1 and ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2), and pursuant to CEQA
  Guidelines Sections 15162 and 15164, no subsequent EIR is required;
  2. Approve and recommend that the City Council adopt, pursuant to Charter Section 558(b)(2) of the City
  Charter, and Chapter 1A Section 13B.1.3 of the Los Angeles Municipal Code (LAMC), the proposed
  HESMD Amendment Ordinance, to amend the Zoning Code including amendments to Chapter 1 and 1A
  of the LAMC, including revisions to sections 16.70, 12.22 A.37, 12.22 A.38, and 12.22 A.39 of Chapter 1
  and any related Code sections of Chapter 1 and Sections 1.5.1, 1.5.13, 1.5.14, 1.5.15, 4C.15.2, 4C.15.4,
  6B.2, 6C.2.1, 9.2.1, 9.2.2, 9.2.3, 9.2.4, 9.2.5, 9.2.6, and 14.3 of Chapter 1A and any related Code sections
  of Chapter 1A;
  3. Approve and recommend the City Council adopt, pursuant to Charter Section 558(b)(2), the Lower Income
  Sites Ordinance;
  4. Adopt the Staff Recommendation Report as the Commission’s report; and
  5. Adopt the Findings.

  Applicant:  City of Los Angeles

  Staff:  Erika Cui, City Planner
  erika.cui@lacity.org
  (818) 374-5046
summary: Citywide zoning code amendments that clarify eligibility and review for housing element sites, let projects use adjacent sites, and adopt the Lower Income Rezoning sites list by ordinance.
